summary: The mismatch is the missing dungeon.c:rm_mapseen call in cmd.c:makemap_prepost(TRUE). C unlinks and discards the old current-level overview node before replacing the level; JS records note_unported and leaves it in state.svm.mapseenchn, then init_mapseen appends another D:1 node. The #overview command consequently renders a duplicate Level 1 row after #wizmakemap.

source.branch: When a level is replaced, find the first mapseen node whose dungeon ledger_start plus dlevel equals the requested ledger number; if found, release its custom annotation and final-resting-place chain, then unlink it from the mapseen list. If no node matches, return without changing the list.

evidence: The saved v47 queue identifies the exact remaining-screen mismatch at segment 0, step 23, the #overview boundary: 5,031/5,031 RNG calls match, while the C overview contains one Level 1 row and JS contains a duplicate. See challenges/manifests/v47.json case v47-rm-mapseen-after-wizmakemap-overview-attempt1-cfirst and the matching case recording SHA in the saved queue.

Upstream dungeon.c:2665-2691 defines all of rm_mapseen: traverse svm.mapseenchn by ledger_start + dlevel; return if absent; free custom annotation; walk/free final_resting_place; unlink the matched node from the head or predecessor. It makes no random calls and writes no output; its game-state effect is removal of that remembered level node.

The only direct C caller is cmd.c:993 in makemap_prepost(TRUE), after makemap_remove_mons and before replacement-level generation. Its already ported JavaScript caller in js/cmd.js:2561-2570 computes ledger_no then currently records note_unported("dungeon.c rm_mapseen") without removing the node. js/dungeon.js:init_mapseen (2364-2387) inserts a new D:1 node in sorted order, accounting for the duplicate.

The production #wizmakemap command reaches the pre path through wizcmds.c:wiz_makemap (161-166) and js/wizcmds.js:wiz_makemap. The separate active #wizloaddes path calls sp_lev.c:lspo_reset_level(NULL) from wizcmds.c:wiz_load_splua (388), which also reaches makemap_prepost(TRUE); existing recording recordings/wizcmds.c/wiz-load-des-explicit.session.json covers that caller route. The v47 case is the runtime evidence for the overview-observable removal behavior.

Upstream sp_lev.c labels lspo_reset_level as testing-only; the second active game entry is the explicit wizcmds.c:wiz_load_splua(NULL) call, whose runtime path is also present in recordings/wizcmds.c/wiz-load-des-explicit.session.json. The C makemap_prepost(FALSE) calls in wiz_makemap and lspo_finalize_level are post-generation paths and do not call rm_mapseen.
